description.value:
You can empower yourself with dark forces and exude a corrupting presence. As a Bonus Action, you gain the following benefits for 10 minutes:

  • You emanate an aura of magical gloom within 30 ft. This counts as dim light and sunlight cannot illuminate this area.
  • Enemy creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against any of your features and spells, as well as those of undead and fiends while within the gloom.
  • When an enemy creature starts its turn in the gloom, it takes 10 necrotic damage. This damage is doubled if the creature is good-aligned.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a 5th-level spell slot to use it again.
